segments.an4.166:1.3: Dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā, dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā, sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
segments.an4.166:2.1: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yāyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā dandhābhiññā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭipadā ubhayeneva hīnā akkhāyati. Yampāyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā, imināpāyaṃ hīnā akkhāyati; yampāyaṃ paṭipadā dandhā, imināpāyaṃ hīnā akkhāyati.
segments.an4.166:2.2: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭipadā ubhayeneva hīnā akkhāyati.
segments.an4.166:3.1: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yāyaṃ paṭipadā dukkhā khippābhiññā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭipadā dukkhattā hīnā akkhāyati.
segments.an4.166:4.1: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā dandhābhiññā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭipadā dandhattā hīnā akkhāyati.
segments.an4.166:5.1: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā khippābhiññā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭipadā ubhayeneva paṇītā akkhāyati. Yampāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā, imināpāyaṃ paṇītā akkhāyati; yampāyaṃ paṭipadā khippā, imināpāyaṃ paṇītā akkhāyati.
segments.an4.166:5.2: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭipadā ubhayeneva paṇītā akkhāyati.

lines: 164-166. Catutthe padhānakaraṇakāle sītādīni nakkhamati na sahatīti akkhamā.
“Uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāsetī”tiādinā (ma. ni.1.26; a. ni.4.14;6.58) nayena vitakkasamanaṃ samāti āha “akusalavitakkānaṃ vūpasamanapaṭipadā”ti.
Nidassanamattañcetaṃ, sabbesampi kilesānaṃ samanavasena pavattā paṭipadā samā.
